title: Adobe Firefly Review (2026)
intro: Adobe Firefly is evaluated here as AI software — Adobe Firefly is Adobe’s generative model family for images, vectors, and (on higher credits) video — integrated with Photoshop, Express, and Firefly web. Free includes a small credit allotment. Standalone Standard is commonly listed around $9.99/mo and Pro around $19.99/mo with premium credit pools; Creative Cloud Pro bundles Firefly credits for designers already in Adobe apps. Commercial IP posture and indemnification are the buying reason vs Midjourney for many brands. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Adobe Firefly when AI images must live in Creative Cloud with a commercial IP story — not as a Midjourney Discord substitute.
verdict: Choose Adobe Firefly when AI images must live in Creative Cloud with a commercial IP story — not as a Midjourney Discord substitute. Compare Midjourney for distinctive stills; ChatGPT if image gen is a side feature of an LLM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.

Standalone through Teams/Enterprise and CC bundles.
~$10 Standard is a low standalone floor; CC subscribers should price the bundle not a second Firefly SKU. Affiliate economics excluded.
Adobe models plus partner models on credits; capability is commercial-safe rather than max-style.
